title: Identification and Inference in proxy-SVARs with non-Gaussian shocks
abstract: arXiv:2609.14398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Two frequent approaches for identifying structural VARs are external instruments, which carry economic content but are often weak, and non-Gaussianity of the shocks which provides statistical identification but carries no economic meaning. We combine the two strategies in a single generalized method of moments framework that stacks proxy exclusion restrictions with higher-order moment conditions of the structural shocks. This hybrid approach point-identifies the target shocks while also identifying the non-target shocks up to sign and ordering. Under suitable rank conditions, the higher-order moments anchor the identification uniformly over the instrument strength. Consequently, under local-to-zero proxy relevance, estimators of the dynamic causal effects remain consistent, and standard asymptotic inference remains valid. translated_title: 非高斯冲击下代理SVAR的识别与推断
translated_abstract: 识别结构向量自回归（SVAR）有两种常用方法：一是外部工具变量（proxy），它承载经济含义但往往较弱；二是冲击的非高斯性，它提供统计识别但不具有经济含义。我们将这两种策略结合在一个统一的广义矩估计（GMM）框架中，把代理排除性约束与结构冲击的高阶矩条件叠加在一起。这种混合方法既能点识别目标冲击，也能在符号和排序意义上识别非目标冲击。在适当的秩条件下，高阶矩能在工具变量强度变化时一致地锚定识别。因此，在代理相关性局部趋于零（local-to-zero）的情形下，动态因果效应的估计量仍保持一致性，标准渐近推断仍然有效。此外，Anderson-Rubin置信集比仅使用工具变量的情形显著更窄。
tldr: 该论文在GMM框架中同时叠加外部工具变量排除性约束与冲击的高阶矩条件来识别SVAR，使得即使工具变量局部趋于无效，动态因果效应估计量仍一致、推断仍有效，且Anderson-Rubin置信集显著更窄。
en_tdlr: This paper combines proxy exclusion restrictions with higher-order non-Gaussian moment conditions in a single GMM framework for SVAR identification, ensuring consistent estimation and valid inference even under local-to-zero instrument relevance while substantially narrowing Anderson-Rubin confidence sets.
